calls.title: Growthbook <> Writer - Intro
calls.summary: GrowthBook's Daniel Wathne (AE) and Logan Bates (SE) met with Writer's Michelle Cho (head of data & analytics) to discuss Writer's need for a cost-effective experimentation platform. Michelle cited pain points with LaunchDarkly's high pricing (~$35k for experimentation) and lack of data trust, seeking a solution under $30k that integrates with their data warehouse (BigQuery/Snowflake) and tools (Segment, FullStory). Next steps: Wathne will send a recap email with a pricing commitment in the desired
